name: RateDX

tenures.role: wrestler: YWA Heavyweight Champion in January 2010; winner of the 30 June 2010 Beat The Clock and a challenger at DESTRUCCION and MASACRE
tenures.note: Champion of January 2010, out of the belt by 6 February. Back on 30 June: beats Criki on the clock, is attacked by Lashley before DESTRUCCION, then wins the 14 July tag with Lashley, beats Super Kane, wins the 27 July tag and loses the MASACRE stretcher match.

caption: The YWA Heavyweight Champion of January 2010, who challenged the chairman to a match at SOBREVIVE, beat the general managers sent against him and lost the belt in a six-man battle royal on 6 February.

name: ANTI BATISTA

tenures.role: authority figure: general manager and chairman of YWA; also a combatant, who attacks RateDX from behind on 29 January 2010
tenures.note: Named the actual Chairman on 29 January 2010, hits RateDX from behind, costs him the 6 February battle royal, announces the reopening on 9 June and sets Lashley a title shot on 23 June; on 30 June he declares the title vacant and on 7 July names a replacement for RateDX.

caption: The promotion's chairman and general manager, who accepted RateDX's challenge for SOBREVIVE and was recovering from it by 22 February, announced the reopening after two months closed on 9 June 2010 and booked the matches of the new era.

name: X-treme Angel

tenures.role: wrestler: winner of the SOBREVIVE Royal Rumble, as the 22 February 2010 show recaps it
tenures.note: Wins the SOBREVIVE Royal Rumble in February 2010; back on 30 June, when Lashley beats him on the clock after a chair attack, and loses the 14 July MASACRE qualifier to El Millonario de Tijuana.

caption: The wrestler who won the SOBREVIVE Royal Rumble, last eliminating El Rey 3, and used it to challenge Campero LWO for the Heavyweight Championship at YAHOOMANIA II.

name: Coke

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: Loses to X-treme Angel (29 January) and The Deadman (6 February); beats Super Kane with a Zig Zag for a MASACRE place on 14 July, eliminates Mik Morrison on 21 July before Dante throws him out, and at MASACRE hits El Aire de Tijuana with a chair and loses to Tijuana Forever.

caption: A wrestler beaten in both of his AWZ matches of early 2010, by X-treme Angel with a GTS and by The Deadman with a Tombstone Piledriver.

name: e HBK y

tenures.role: wrestler: YWA Alliance Tag Team Champion from AMANECER 2010 with The Deadman; YWA Legend Champion from 6 February 2010
tenures.note: Returns at AMANECER to win the Alliance Tag Team Championships with The Deadman, wins the 29 January tag match with Rabid Y2J, takes the Legend Championship from El Juez on 6 February and loses the Alliance belts on 22 February.

caption: The wrestler who returned at AMANECER 2010 to take the Alliance Tag Team Championships with The Deadman, won the Legend Championship from El Juez on 6 February and was named the first YWA Grand Slam Champion.

name: Rabid Y2J

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: The AMANECER report mentions his remark to Evan Mysterio; the recap on 29 January puts him in the main event, pinned after a Canadian Destroyer, and he pins El Juez that night partnering e HBK y.

caption: A wrestler in the AMANECER 2010 main event, pinned there by RateDX, who partnered e HBK y to beat El Juez and The Legend Killer Lashley on 29 January.

name: The Legend Killer Lashley

tenures.role: wrestler: YWA World Heavyweight Champion from DESTRUCCION, 7 July 2010
tenures.note: Wrecks the heavyweight champion's match on 23 June; beats X-treme Angel on the clock on 30 June and Criki for the title at DESTRUCCION; teams with RateDX on 14 July, beats Criki (21 July) and El Aire de Tijuana (27 July), is attacked by RateDX, and retains in the MASACRE stretcher match.

caption: A self-styled legend who attacked Omega Legend backstage with a fire extinguisher, beat Asesino on 23 June 2010 to become number one contender for the Heavyweight Championship, and then took the belt after wrecking the champion's match.

identity.note: Exact-name collision with unrelated records in other federations; no document ties any of them to this one. Kept distinct under the no-merge default.

name: El Juez

tenures.role: wrestler: YWA Legend Champion until 6 February 2010
tenures.note: Interferes in the AMANECER main event, is pinned by Rabid Y2J on 29 January 2010, loses the Legend title to e HBK y (6 February) and to Asesino (16 June), and submits to Tijuana Forever on 30 June.

caption: The Legend Champion who interfered in the AMANECER 2010 main event, lost the belt to e HBK y with a single Sweet Chin Music on 6 February and lost a second Legend title match, to Asesino, on 16 June.

name: Evan Mysterio

tenures.role: wrestler and general manager; submits to RateDX on 29 January 2010
tenures.note: Called another general manager of YWA, he is Mr. Anderson's victim at AMANECER in the report, submits to RateDX on 29 January and is thrown out of the 6 February battle royal by The Deadman; the second card bills him against El Rey 3.

caption: A wrestler and general manager who lost his AMANECER 2010 match to a surprise entrant, was made to submit to RateDX on 29 January and was thrown out of the 6 February battle royal by The Deadman.

name: The Deadman

tenures.role: wrestler: YWA Alliance Tag Team Champion with e HBK y until 22 February 2010
tenures.note: Wins the Alliance Tag Team Championships with e HBK y at AMANECER, beats Coke on 6 February, is the last man thrown out by Campero LWO in the battle royal, and is pinned by Lethal Consequece on 22 February as the belts change hands.

caption: An Alliance Tag Team Champion with e HBK y from AMANECER 2010, who beat Coke, finished second to Campero LWO in the 6 February battle royal and lost the belts on 22 February.

identity.note: Exact-name collision with unrelated records in other federations; no document ties any of them to this one. Kept distinct under the no-merge default.

name: Omega Legend

tenures.role: wrestler: a past YWA heavyweight title holder, as the chairman calls him
tenures.note: Named in the AMANECER Table Match with Lost Hero and beaten by RateDX on 6 February; on 9 June Lashley attacks him backstage and wins by default, and on 16 June Lashley beats him in the rematch the card billed as his chance at revenge.

caption: A past heavyweight title holder who fought in the AMANECER 2010 Table Match, lost to RateDX on 6 February and lost twice to Lashley in June, the first time by default after a backstage attack.

name: Campero LWO

tenures.role: wrestler: YWA Heavyweight Champion from 6 February 2010
tenures.note: A newcomer billed against The Legend Fuker on the card of the second show, he wins the six-man battle royal of 6 February as new champion and on 22 February teams with El Rey 3 to beat X-treme Angel and RateDX; RateDX demands his rematch and X-treme Angel and El Rey 3 each ask for his belt at YAHOOMANIA II.

caption: The newcomer who won the six-man battle royal of 6 February 2010 to become YWA Heavyweight Champion and was challenged for the belt at YAHOOMANIA II.

name: El Rey 3

tenures.role: wrestler: runner-up in the SOBREVIVE Royal Rumble
tenures.note: Billed against Evan Mysterio on the second card; the 22 February recap makes him the last man X-treme Angel eliminated in the SOBREVIVE Royal Rumble, and that night he teams with Campero LWO, pinning X-treme Angel after three moonsaults.

caption: The runner-up of the SOBREVIVE Royal Rumble, who asked for a shot at the Heavyweight Championship at YAHOOMANIA II and teamed with Campero LWO to beat X-treme Angel and RateDX on 22 February 2010.

name: Hanoi Kid

tenures.role: local wrestler
tenures.note: RateDX's opponent in the exhibition match that opens the 6 February show; he gives up to an angle lock and is hit with a Canadian Destroyer and a Tiger Driver 91 after the hold is broken.

caption: The local wrestler who gave up to RateDX's angle lock in the exhibition match of 6 February 2010 and was then carried out.

name: Dolph Ziggler

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: Loses to The Legend Killer Lashley on 22 February 2010 to a big boot, a military press and a Tombstone Piledriver.

caption: The opponent Lashley beat with a Tombstone Piledriver on 22 February 2010 to announce himself for YAHOOMANIA II.

name: Ivan G

tenures.role: wrestler: YWA Alliance Tag Team Champion with Lethal Consequece from 22 February 2010
tenures.note: With Lethal Consequece beats e HBK y and The Deadman on 22 February 2010 for the Alliance Tag Team Championships.

caption: An Alliance Tag Team Champion with Lethal Consequece, crowned on 22 February 2010 by beating e HBK y and The Deadman.

name: Lethal Consequece

tenures.role: wrestler: YWA Alliance Tag Team Champion with Ivan G from 22 February 2010
tenures.note: Pins The Deadman with a Suicide Solution on 22 February 2010 to win the Alliance Tag Team Championships with Ivan G.

caption: The Alliance Tag Team Champion who pinned The Deadman with a Suicide Solution on 22 February 2010 to win the belts with Ivan G.

name: Steve

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: Thrown out of the 9 June 2010 qualifying battle royal by El Aire de Tijuana; with Midota M he loses the tag qualifier of 16 June to Luis15 and Jericho, and the card of 16 June bills him in a dark match.

caption: A newcomer eliminated from the qualifying battle royal of the 9 June 2010 reopening and beaten with Midota M in the tag qualifier a week later.

identity.note: Exact-name collision with unrelated records in other federations; no document ties any of them to this one. Kept distinct under the no-merge default.

name: Midota M

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: Thrown out of the 9 June 2010 qualifying battle royal by Jericho and pinned by Jericho in the tag qualifier of 16 June partnering Steve; the card of 16 June bills him in a dark match.

caption: A newcomer thrown out of the 9 June 2010 qualifying battle royal by Jericho and pinned by him in the tag qualifier a week later.

name: Luis15

tenures.role: wrestler: Alliance Tag Team challenger with Jericho
tenures.note: Sets the 5:54 time on 30 June; he and Jericho lose the Alliance title match to the TWO at DESTRUCCION and he attacks Jericho after it; beats Soplo on 14 July, is last but one in the 21 July battle royal, loses to Dante on 27 July, beats El Millonario and loses the semifinal at MASACRE.

caption: The tag partner of Jericho, who qualified for a title shot on 16 June 2010 and lost it to TWO a week later.

name: Jericho

tenures.role: wrestler: Alliance Tag Team challenger with Luis15; YWA Extreme Champion from MASACRE, 6 August 2010
tenures.note: Plays a time-limit match with El Aire de Tijuana on 30 June; he and Luis15 lose the Alliance title match to the TWO at DESTRUCCION; draws with Soplo by count out on 21 July, beats him in the Extreme Rules Match at MASACRE for the Extreme Championship, and wins the 27 July tag with RateDX.

caption: The tag partner of Luis15, who threw Midota M out of the 9 June 2010 battle royal, pinned him a week later to earn a title shot and lost it to TWO.

identity.note: Exact-name collision with unrelated records in other federations; no document ties any of them to this one. Kept distinct under the no-merge default.

name: Tijuana Forever

tenures.role: wrestler: winner of the qualifying battle royal of 9 June 2010; YWA Alliance Tag Team Champion with El Aire de Tijuana from 23 June 2010; finalist of the MASACRE tournament
tenures.note: Submits El Juez on the clock on 30 June, retains the Alliance belts with El Aire de Tijuana at DESTRUCCION, loses to Dante's spear on 14 July, wins the 21 July eight-man battle royal and, at MASACRE, beats Coke and Luis15 before losing the tournament final to Mik Morrison.

caption: The winner of the qualifying battle royal of 9 June 2010, who made it into the scramble match for the vacant Heavyweight Championship and, as half of TWO, took the Alliance Tag Team Championships on 23 June.

name: El Aire de Tijuana

tenures.role: wrestler: Alliance Tag Team Champion with Tijuana Forever from 23 June 2010
tenures.note: Plays a time-limit match with Jericho on 30 June, finishes the Alliance title match at DESTRUCCION with a Kryptonite Krunch, is thrown out of the 21 July battle royal, loses to Lashley's Sharpshooter on 27 July and is hurt by Coke's chair before their MASACRE Chair Match.

caption: The high-flyer who eliminated Steve and Jericho on 9 June 2010 and finished the title match of 23 June with a Shooting Star Press as half of the new Alliance Tag Team Champions TWO.

name: The Prince Phenomenal Mr. TNA

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: Refuses to fight Criki at DESTRUCCION and loses by count out; beats Asesino on 14 July for a MASACRE place, is thrown out of the 21 July battle royal, loses to Mik Morrison on 27 July and, at MASACRE, to Dante on thumbtacks.

caption: A qualifier-round loser of 9 June 2010 who walked out on his tag partner The Phenomenal Mizard a week later.

name: Big Evil

tenures.role: wrestler: first interim champion in the scramble match of 9 June 2010
tenures.note: Wins his 9 June 2010 qualifier over The Prince Phenomenal Mr. TNA with a Shooting Star Press and is the first interim champion of the scramble match before Showtime Mr. PPV pins him; the card bills him against the new champion next.

caption: The wrestler who won his qualifier with a Shooting Star Press on 9 June 2010 and was the first interim champion of the scramble match for the vacant Heavyweight Championship.

name: Showtime Mr. PPV

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: Beats The Phenomenal Mizard with a Five Star Frog Splash on 9 June 2010 and takes the interim title from Big Evil in the scramble match; the cards of 9 and 16 June bill him against Criki and MaFia KiiNG.

caption: The wrestler who beat The Phenomenal Mizard with a Five Star Frog Splash on 9 June 2010 and held the interim title for a spell in the scramble match.

name: The Phenomenal Mizard

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: Loses to Showtime Mr. PPV in the qualifier of 9 June 2010; on 16 June he is left alone by his partner The Prince Phenomenal Mr. TNA and pinned by El Aire de Tijuana; the card of 16 June bills him in a dark match.

caption: A wrestler who lost his qualifier on 9 June 2010 and was left alone in the ring by his tag partner a week later.

name: The Xtreme Tiger Checo

tenures.role: wrestler: YWA Heavyweight Champion from 9 June 2010
tenures.note: Wins the 9 June scramble match, teams with Criki on 14 July against RateDX and Lashley and gives up to RateDX's angle lock.

caption: The wrestler who won the scramble match of 9 June 2010 for the vacant YWA Heavyweight Championship, feuded with Criki, and saw Lashley take the belt on 23 June.

name: Criki

tenures.role: wrestler: feuding with the Heavyweight Champion The Xtreme Tiger Checo
tenures.note: Loses to RateDX on the clock on 30 June; substitutes for RateDX at DESTRUCCION and loses the title match to Lashley; loses the 14 July tag, the 21 July hardcore match and the 27 July tag, and loses the MASACRE stretcher match.

caption: The wrestler who lost his qualifier to The Xtreme Tiger Checo on 9 June 2010, then took revenge with a Sweet Chin Music and demanded a match with the champion.

name: Asesino

tenures.role: wrestler: YWA Legend Champion from 16 June to 7 July 2010
tenures.note: Wins the Legend title from El Juez on 16 June 2010, loses to Lashley on 23 June, is billed against Angel Omar Soto on 30 June, loses the title to Mik Morrison at DESTRUCCION and loses to Mr Phenomenal TNA on 14 July.

caption: The wrestler who won the YWA Legend Championship from El Juez on 16 June 2010 and lost to Lashley a week later in a match that put Lashley's title shot on the line.

identity.note: Exact-name collision with unrelated records in other federations; no document ties any of them to this one. Kept distinct under the no-merge default.

name: Dante

tenures.role: wrestler: YWA Y Division Champion from DESTRUCCION, 7 July 2010
tenures.note: Ties the 30 June battle royal for the vacant Y Division title with Soplo and beats him for it at DESTRUCCION, wins the 14 July tag with Mik Morrison and spears him after it, beats Luis15 on 27 July; at MASACRE he loses to Mik, beats Mr TNA and loses to Mik again in the semifinal.

caption: The wrestler who won the YWA Y Division Championship from Soplo at DESTRUCCION on 7 July 2010 after the two had tied a battle royal for the vacant title, and who lost twice to Mik Morrison at MASACRE.

identity.note: Exact-name collision with unrelated records in other federations; no document ties any of them to this one. Kept distinct under the no-merge default.

name: Soplo

tenures.role: wrestler: Y Division title challenger at DESTRUCCION; first challenger in the revived Extreme Championship match at MASACRE
tenures.note: Eliminates Stan and ties the 30 June battle royal with Dante, loses the Y Division title match to him at DESTRUCCION and the 14 July qualifier to Luis15, draws by count out with Jericho on 21 July and loses the Extreme Rules Match to him at MASACRE.

caption: The wrestler who tied the 30 June 2010 battle royal for the vacant Y Division title, lost the title match to Dante at DESTRUCCION and lost the Extreme Rules Match against Jericho at MASACRE.

name: Mik Morrison

tenures.role: wrestler: YWA Legend Champion from DESTRUCCION, 7 July 2010; winner of the MASACRE tournament
tenures.note: Beats The Bulldog Volcanic on 30 June to challenge for the Legend title and takes it from Asesino at DESTRUCCION, wins the 14 July tag with Dante, who spears him after, beats Mr TNA on 27 July, then Dante twice and Tijuana Forever to win the MASACRE tournament and a heavyweight title shot.

caption: The Legend Champion from DESTRUCCION who won the MASACRE tournament on 6 August 2010 by beating Dante in the semifinal and Tijuana Forever in a steel-cage final, and so became the challenger for the heavyweight title.

name: Super Kane

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: Loses the 14 July qualifier for the MASACRE tournament to Coke with a Zig Zag and, on 21 July, gives up to RateDX's angle lock, which RateDX keeps on after the bell.

caption: A wrestler beaten in both of his AWZ matches of July 2010, by Coke in a MASACRE qualifier and by RateDX's angle lock.

name: El Millonario de Tijuana

tenures.role: wrestler: member of the TWO (the Tijuana World Order)
tenures.note: Beats X-treme Angel in the 14 July qualifier, appears with the TWO on 21 July, is thrown out of the eight-man battle royal by Luis15 and loses to him in the first round of the MASACRE tournament. The TWO's promos of 10 July call him El Millonario del Kartel.

caption: A member of the TWO who qualified for the MASACRE tournament by beating X-treme Angel on 14 July 2010 and lost to Luis15 in a Kendo Match in its first round.

name: The Bulldog Volcanic

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: Loses to Mik Morrison with a Moonlight Driver in the 30 June match whose winner would challenge the Legend Champion at DESTRUCCION.

caption: The wrestler beaten by Mik Morrison on 30 June 2010 in the match for the Legend title challenge at DESTRUCCION.

name: The Best Austin

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: Loses to Luis15 on 30 June in the first Beat The Clock match, which set the time of 5:54 for the others to beat.

caption: The wrestler beaten by Luis15 in the first Beat The Clock match of 30 June 2010, which set the first time to beat.

name: Stan

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: Eliminated by Soplo from the 30 June battle royal for the vacant Y Division title.

caption: A wrestler thrown out by Soplo in the 30 June 2010 battle royal for the vacant Y Division title.

identity.note: Exact-name collision with unrelated records in other federations; no document ties any of them to this one. Kept distinct under the no-merge default.

name: JØhn ¢£nÂ

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: Thrown to ringside by Dante in the 30 June battle royal for the vacant Y Division title after trying a finishing lift.

caption: A wrestler thrown out by Dante in the 30 June 2010 battle royal for the vacant Y Division title.

name: Jesus Antonio

tenures.role: wrestler
tenures.note: The first man out of the 30 June battle royal for the vacant Y Division title, caught by Dante with a lasso to the neck.

caption: The first wrestler eliminated, by Dante, from the 30 June 2010 battle royal for the vacant Y Division title.
